import{useCallback,useEffect,useMemo,useState}from"react";import{useForm}from"react-hook-form";import{useDispatch,useSelector}from"react-redux";import{showErrorToast,showSuccessToast}from"common/ToastMessage";import CommonMessage from"common/CommonMessage";import{createEmailSetup,getEmailSetups,updateEmailSetup}from"modules/administration/slices/emailSetupSlice";const useEmailSetupForm=()=>{const dispatch=useDispatch();const[createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen]=useState(false);const[editValues,setEditValues]=useState([]);// row values to edit
